drugs.name: Metformin
drugs.mechanism: AMPK activator suppressing hepatic gluconeogenesis and enhancing peripheral insulin sensitivity
drugs.efficacy: First-line standard of care pharmacotherapy for glycemic control
drugs.adverse_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, abdominal discomfort, rare lactic acidosis

drugs.name: Semaglutide
drugs.mechanism: GLP-1 receptor agonist stimulating glucose-dependent insulin release and suppressing glucagon
drugs.efficacy: Potent HbA1c reduction and major adverse cardiovascular event (MACE) reduction
drugs.adverse_effects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, rare pancreatitis

drugs.name: Empagliflozin
drugs.mechanism: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor promoting urinary glucose excretion
drugs.efficacy: Lowers glucose, reduces cardiovascular death, and provides renal protection
drugs.adverse_effects: Mycotic genital infections, urinary tract infections, volume depletion, euglycemic DKA

drugs.name: Tirzepatide
drugs.mechanism: Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist enhancing insulin secretion and satiety
drugs.efficacy: Superior glycemic efficacy and substantial body weight reduction
drugs.adverse_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, decreased appetite, vomiting, dyspepsia

drugs.name: Sitagliptin
drugs.mechanism: Dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitor prolonging endogenous GLP-1 and GIP activity
drugs.efficacy: Well-tolerated oral incretin enhancer with low hypoglycemia risk
drugs.adverse_effects: Nasopharyngitis, upper respiratory tract infection, headache
